name: FD.io VPP (Vector Packet Processing)
description: Vector Packet Processing platform — extensible framework providing production-quality switch/router functionality. Open-source version of Cisco VPP technology for high-performance packet processing on commodity CPUs.

docker_support.docker_evidence: No official Docker images from FD.io; community images from ligato/vpp-base and travelping/vpp. Containerlab provides FD.io VPP images for lab scenarios.

eval_notes: High-performance data plane (10Gbps+). Good for testing forwarding plane scenarios, SR, IPsec tunnels. Community Docker images via Ligato and Travelping. Pairs well with Ligato VPP Agent for control plane management. High-performance userspace networking. Native containerlab support (kind: fdio_vpp). IPng Networks provides containerlab-ready image at git.ipng.ch/ipng/vpp-containerlab. Linux Control Plane plugin for kernel integration.
